business.name: Zara Perfumes
business.about: Family-run attar and perfume house in the heart of Calicut since 2009. We blend imported oud and fresh florals into long-lasting fragrances — every bottle is hand-checked before it reaches you.
business.whatsapp_greeting: Hi Zara Perfumes! I just browsed your catalogue. Can you help me pick a fragrance?
business.chatbot_greeting: Hi! Welcome to Zara Perfumes 🌸 How can I help you today?

products.name: Royal Oud
products.short_description: A rich, woody fragrance with hints of rose.
products.long_description: Royal Oud is our signature fragrance — a deep, luxurious blend of aged oud wood, Bulgarian rose, and warm amber. Perfect for evening wear and special occasions. Lasts 8–10 hours on skin.

products.name: Rose Mist
products.short_description: Fresh Damask rose water spray for everyday wear.
products.long_description: Rose Mist captures the scent of fresh Damask roses picked at dawn. Light, airy, and never overpowering — ideal for office wear and daily use. Spray on pulse points or lightly on clothes. Lasts 4–5 hours.

products.name: Oud Rose
products.short_description: Our bestselling fusion of smoky oud and sweet rose.
products.long_description: Oud Rose is the fragrance our customers reorder the most. Smoky Cambodian oud meets sweet Taif rose in a perfectly balanced attar. Unisex, intense, and unforgettable — a little goes a long way. Lasts 10–12 hours.

products.name: Jasmine Dreams
products.short_description: Night-blooming jasmine with a creamy sandalwood base.
products.long_description: Jasmine Dreams is inspired by Kerala's night-blooming jasmine (kutti mulla). Heady white florals settle into a soft, creamy sandalwood base. A favourite for weddings and festive occasions. Lasts 6–8 hours.

products.name: Lavender Cloud
products.short_description: Calming French lavender, perfect for daily wear.
products.long_description: Lavender Cloud blends French lavender with a whisper of vanilla and white musk. Soft, calming, and clean — customers tell us they wear it to sleep better. Great as a gift too. Lasts 5–6 hours.

products.name: Black Amber
products.short_description: Limited-edition dark amber and oud blend.
products.long_description: Black Amber is our limited small-batch release — dark amber resin, smoked oud, and a touch of saffron. Only a few bottles are made each month, so pricing varies by batch. WhatsApp us for the current price and availability.

faqs.question: Do you deliver outside Kerala?
faqs.answer: Yes! We ship all over India. Delivery takes 3–5 business days and we share tracking on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We accept returns within 7 days if the product is unopened and the seal is intact.

faqs.question: Are your ingredients authentic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our oud is sourced from certified suppliers in Cambodia and Assam, and our floral oils are steam-distilled. Every batch is tested before bottling.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Gift wrapping with a handwritten note is free on all orders above ₹1,000. Just mention it on WhatsApp when you order.
